title: Company Jobs API: Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable
description: Get every open job from company career pages that run on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters or Recruitee, in one clean format: title, location, remote, department, type, salary where published, posted date, apply link and full description. Paste careers URLs or just company names.

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Careers page URLs (for example https://boards.greenhouse.io/airbnb, https://jobs.lever.co/spotify, https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/openai) or plain company names (each board is tried). Up to 1,000 per run.

titleKeywords.title: Title keywords
titleKeywords.description: Only jobs whose title contains any of these (optional).

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Only jobs whose location contains any of these, for example London or Remote (optional).

remoteOnly.title: Remote jobs only
remoteOnly.description: Only return jobs marked remote (or with Remote in the location).

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)
postedWithinDays.description: 0 = any date. Boards that do not publish a date are kept.

includeDescription.title: Include job description
includeDescription.description: Plain-text description (up to 20,000 characters). Switch off for smaller output.

job.title: Job returned
job.description: One job posting returned after your filters. Companies with no board found are free.

store.seoTitle: Company Jobs API - Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable
store.seoDescription: All open jobs from company career pages on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters and Recruitee. Clean JSON, filters, $1 per 1,000 jobs.
